title: Playboy Magazine March 1980 Bo Derek "10" Complete w/ Centerfold Terry Bradshaw
conditionDescription: Vintage 1980 issue. Covers bright with light wear; small faint water spot on the front cover (right of the model's arm, see photo 2). Back cover has white specks/scuffing on the dark ad. Spine intact. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, March 1980 issue (Vol. 27 No. 3), original $2.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: Bo Derek, "The '10' Girl." Also: John Connally, the canny conservative; "Pot Power: Who'll Cash In if They Legalize Grass?"; Terry Bradshaw, an irreverent interview with the N.F.L.'s best quarterback.

Back cover: Viceroy Rich Lights 100's cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
